description: Discover insider trading patterns across multiple companies (the whole universe, not a single ticker): insiders active across multiple companies, cluster buying patterns, and large transactions. Optional filters: insider name, transaction type, or date range. Cluster buying is computed only for purchases (transactionType P, the default). Useful for detecting coordinated insider activity, cross-company insider networks, and market-wide buying/selling trends.

endDate.description: End date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., "2025-12-31"); a full ISO timestamp is cut to its date.

insiderName.description: Filter by insider name (partial match, e.g., "Musk" or "Cohen")

startDate.description: Start date, YYYY-MM-DD (e.g., "2025-01-01"); a full ISO timestamp is cut to its date. Either bound may be given alone; with both, startDate must be on or before endDate. An unparseable date is rejected, never ignored. With no dates the lookback is the last 90 days.

transactionType.description: Filter by transaction type, one of P, S, A, M, F, G, D, C, X (default P): "P" (purchase), "S" (sale), "A" (grant/award), "M" (exercise/conversion), "F" (tax withholding), "G" (gift), "D" (disposition to issuer), "C" (conversion), "X" (option exercise). Other values are rejected.

name: get_insider_cross_company
title: Get Cross-Company Insider Trading
